title: Application release record
description: Declarative contract for apps/releases/<application>.json in the owning GitOps repository. Decision D44: JSON stays the native release record format; there is no YAML migration. Mirrors release.validate(): an immutable primary digest, the exact published source revision and the publishing workflow run, with optional bounded multi-component digests. JSON Schema cannot express primary-component membership or digest equality; the release proposer still enforces that primary_component names a component whose digest equals digest.

digest.description: Immutable primary image digest. The deployed image is <repository>@<digest>.

source_revision.description: Exact application source commit the image was built from.

workflow_run_id.description: Publishing workflow run id, kept as a string.

components.description: Bounded named component digests. Requires primary_component.

primary_component.description: Names the component whose digest equals digest. Requires components.
